precursor_to: Coax ROADMAP R16; not completion of R13, R15 or R16
solver: oscillator-rk4-f64-v1 at completed RK4 step boundaries
clock: Plain integer completed-step count and one fixed F64 dt; not a typed clock or wall deadline
acceptance: Atomic ordered append; each pending input applies in FIFO order. Only accepted pending inputs are saved; later unaccepted events must be supplied again from an external event log.

included: ordered accepted pending force words and count
serial worker and completed-step integration inventory
absent_by_plant_design: random-stream state: solver has no RNG
integration/warmstart history: closed-step RK4 is Markov in q/v
entity IDs/generations: one implicit oscillator, no R5 entity system

identity_scope: Caller supplies authenticated expected context. Equality and tagged hashes detect mismatch/change; they do not authenticate a forged snapshot or attest the executing machine. Native qualification binds build ID to the actual executable SHA256 and records the observed FP environment.
comparison: Same-context traces only; compare completed tick, then applied force bits, position bits, velocity bits; first mismatch names tick/field/source output operation. This identifies a differing recorded output, not necessarily its earliest internal cause.
native_scope: Within each exact executable on one qualified target/architecture and fixed observed FP environment. Native mode traces must match bitwise; snapshots intentionally differ in build ID/digest, and cross-build restore must refuse. No cross-architecture claim.
